question: One of the key technological shifts in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) includes the introduction of which of the following systems?

options.text: Virtual trial-only courts for all offenses

solution:
The correct answer is __**e-FIR, e-summons and e-warrants**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)** is a proposed legislation aimed at overhauling India’s criminal justice system, bringing in significant technological advancements to improve efficiency and transparency. 
• One of the primary technological shifts under BNSS is the introduction of **e-FIR, e-summons, and e-warrants**, ensuring faster and more efficient processing of cases and reducing delays in legal procedures. 
• An **e-FIR** enables citizens to lodge First Information Reports (FIRs) online, eliminating the need to visit police stations physically, thus increasing accessibility and reducing inconvenience.
